ash: quick heads-up 14  jpn locale CI is failing for the onboarding guide. looks like frontmatter YAML is invalid in `docs/onboarding/quickstart.ja.mdx` 

ash: error from preview: `Failed to parse frontmatter: did not find expected key` when building the localized page. stacktrace points to the slug line.

i18n-bot: localization-scan: parsing error in docs/onboarding/quickstart.ja.mdx at line 3: `slug: onboarding/quickstart-ja:` -> Trailing colon detected.

nora: ack. i touched that file during the l10n pass yesterday, probably left an extra colon while adding `preferred_locale` frontmatter. i'll fix and push a tiny PR.

sam: quick ask  can you also add `translation_note` in frontmatter with the original english title? helps future translators. one-liner.

nora: good idea. i'll add `translation_note: "Orig: Quickstart (Runtime)"` and remove the stray colon.

nora: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4235  changes: fix YAML slug, add translation_note, add smoke check showing `yfm parse` success. includes `yfm parse docs/onboarding/quickstart.ja.mdx` output in PR description.

ash: thanks, tagging sam for quick review. i can approve after CI green.

sam: quick CR: LGTM, left tiny wording nit in translation_note but non-blocking.

ci-bot: ci: locale-preview job triggered by PR #4235  status: success at 1763123900  artifacts: jpn-preview.zip

ash: verified the jpn preview site and the page loads. thanks nora and team :rocket:

nora: merging now and will re-run full localization scan.

i18n-bot: scheduled: re-run localization-scan in 7 days to catch similar frontmatter issues.
